scope: Two real same-host processes consume a shared local SQLite queue using 19 preserved valid source samples and two explicitly controlled failures; no production throughput or distributed-storage claim.
clock_fixture: Between rounds, only selected known candidate next_check=0,last_checked=-1; real retry timestamps unchanged.
limitations: Controlled replay reproduces reported HTTP/connection failures; it does not assert current external availability.
Consumers use unmodified ContinuousEngine, not Celery/Redis.
Other validation tasks share the host; measured times do not isolate queue policy.

metrics.scope: owner_history; cycle duration includes queue delay; retries are attempts after the first
